name: Weekly Piercing Feature
headline: Ask what piercing feature is open this week
description: Work of Art keeps one permanent piercing specials page so clients can check current piercing availability without chasing old weekly URLs. Text or book online for this week's featured placement, jewelry-fit options, and same-day openings.
jewelryTerms: Starter jewelry, fit, and upgrade options are confirmed during the consult.
exclusions: Some placements depend on anatomy, healing history, age policy, and piercer availability.
altText: Curated helix, tragus, and lobe piercings at Work of Art Tattoo and Piercing in Las Vegas
